title: State Department UAP Cable 3, Tbilisi, Georgia, October 30, 2001
doc_notes: This document is a State Department cable from the U.S. Embassy in Moscow discussing diplomatic tensions regarding alleged Russian military incursions into Georgia, where Russian officials dismissively referred to the unidentified aircraft as UFOs.

incidents.summary: Alleged violation of Georgian airspace and bombing of Kodori Gorge by unidentified aircraft, which Russian officials suggested could have been UFOs.
incidents.explanation: Russian officials denied involvement and suggested the unidentified aircraft could have been UFOs; U.S. embassy staff characterized this as a 'bold lie' to conceal Russian military actions.
incidents.quote: reports of planes in the area might as well have been about 'UFOS.'
